domains.title: Debugging from symptoms to causal evidence

objectives.text: Write an observation record that separates actual output, expected contract, inference and an untested hypothesis.
Reproduce a bounded failure with input, source/image/configuration/environment identities and a finite timeout.
Predict two competing causes and select a discriminating observation before changing the program.

subtopics.title: Build diagnostics, assertions and bounded logs

objectives.text: Interpret warnings and generate a matching debug-information build while retaining the production optimization comparison.
Separate internal assertions from durable external validation and make a bounded diagnostic log preserve the first useful cause.
Demonstrate that disabled assertions or logs do not erase required validation or evaluate diagnostic-only side effects.
Define PASS, same-failure FAIL and UNRESOLVED outcomes with a stable finite replay contract.
Implement a bounded original token reducer using subset/complement trials and preserve the failing input grammar.
Check every single remaining deletion to certify 1-minimality and explain why it does not prove global minimality or causal code repair.
Use source and instruction stepping to stop before the first contract-violating transition in a learner-owned C program.
Select frames and scopes to distinguish the current local, a shadowed name and the caller’s arguments.
Record a backtrace with matching symbols and state what optimized-out or unavailable values prevent it from proving.
Choose a pure conditional breakpoint or valid-object watchpoint from a falsifiable hypothesis.
Compare the first observed changed value with the earliest invalid state and account for hardware/software stopping granularity.
Document target width/slot, thread and lifetime limits and choose a bounded alternative when the watch cannot be installed.

subtopics.title: Optimized images, ABI, disassembly and cores

objectives.text: Map a stopped instruction to a source range and explain a missing variable or moved statement in an optimized build.
Check the selected ABI’s preserved-register and frame obligations without treating source stack pictures as a physical guarantee.
Pair a core or saved snapshot with its exact image/symbols and distinguish a stopped state from unavailable execution history.

subtopics.title: Memory fault diagnosis through reused invariants

objectives.text: Locate a bounds, lifetime or initialization contract violation in an isolated learner-owned program using existing T03/T16/T21/T32 artifacts.
Reconcile sanitizer, unsanitized Memcheck and source-level evidence while retaining unsupported or clean-run uncertainty.
Repair the first invalid access or ownership transition and transfer the diagnosis to a changed input without prescribing a UB symptom.

subtopics.title: I/O, errno and descriptor failure histories

objectives.text: Trace positive partial progress, zero/EOF, EINTR and EAGAIN/EWOULDBLOCK without discarding or duplicating bytes.
Capture errno only after the relevant failure and diagnose EPIPE/SIGPIPE and bounded per-process descriptor exhaustion.
Repair cursor/ownership cleanup under the declared Linux close contract and explain its POSIX.1-2024 portability limit.
Reconstruct a forced event schedule, happens-before obligations and a wait-for graph while separating mutex correctness from timing observations.
Diagnose a race, deadlock or predicate/wakeup defect using reused T24/T25 programs and whole-thread observations.
Test a causal synchronization repair with controlled schedules and detector runs while leaving unobserved schedules open.

subtopics.title: Bare-metal startup, faults and asynchronous state

objectives.text: Trace the selected F439 reset/vector/startup path and decode a bounded basic exception/fault record using accepted T27/T29/T31 evidence.
Discriminate a bad peripheral setup, invalid stacked state and ISR/DMA ownership defect without blindly reading side-effecting MMIO.
Repair a documented initialization or completion invariant and keep static, emulator and physical-target claims separate.

subtopics.title: Sanitizer, static, fuzz and differential evidence

objectives.text: Select tools for a specified defect class and record their scope, instrumentation perturbation and actual availability.
Generate bounded original inputs and differential checks that compare the same contract and preserve the failing seed.
Triangulate a dynamic report, static alarm and minimized source transition without equating tool silence with correctness.

subtopics.title: Causal repair, regression and delayed blind transfer

objectives.text: Explain a repair in terms of the violated invariant and reject a symptom-only patch with a competing counterexample.
Replay the minimized trigger, adjacent boundary cases and matched debug/release/instrumented builds with explicit observation categories.
Diagnose a delayed unseen variant from an evidence dossier and record remaining claims instead of reusing memorized diagnostic strings.
